Nina keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Lily and Nina are preparing a report about the picnic ground. Nina ordered noodles and coffee at the class meeting last night. In fact, the lake lay serenely beneath the first light of morning.
Little by little, things began to change. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. In fact, do you mind if I open the blind?

People around Nina often share different ideas about the picnic ground. On Monday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The gala is black tie this year.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. The picnic ground looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, a shout-out from her mentor helped.
The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Nina thanked Lily for the honest advice. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
